vi.firstStep: Tiep tuc trong cua so phat hanh

zh.sub: releaseReady / releaseReadyCheck / releaseReadyLatest 全部通过，当前可继续放行流程。
zh.firstStep: 先执行发布窗口确认，再按标准步骤发布。

en.sub: releaseReady, releaseReadyCheck, and releaseReadyLatest all passed, so release flow can continue.
en.firstStep: Run release-window confirmation first, then follow standard release steps.

vi.sub: releaseReady, releaseReadyCheck va releaseReadyLatest deu dat, co the tiep tuc quy trinh phat hanh.
vi.firstStep: Xac nhan cua so phat hanh truoc, sau do lam theo cac buoc phat hanh chuan.

vi.sub: It nhat mot buoc that bai

zh.sub: 至少一个步骤失败或主结论为 NO-GO，当前禁止放行。
zh.firstStep: 先处理失败步骤（steps.*.ok=false）对应问题，再重跑 sync-check。

en.sub: At least one step failed or decision is NO-GO, so release must be blocked now.
en.firstStep: Fix the issue of the failed step (steps.*.ok=false), then rerun sync-check.

vi.sub: Co it nhat mot buoc loi hoac decision la NO-GO, tam thoi phai chan phat hanh.
vi.firstStep: Xu ly loi o buoc that bai (steps.*.ok=false), sau do chay lai sync-check.

conditions: decision is missing or decision not in ['GO','NO-GO']
exitCode is missing or exitCode not in [0,1]
any of steps.releaseReady.ok/steps.releaseReadyCheck.ok/steps.releaseReadyLatest.ok is missing or not boolean
decision == 'GO' && (steps.releaseReady.ok == false || steps.releaseReadyCheck.ok == false || steps.releaseReadyLatest.ok == false)
decision == 'NO-GO' && steps.releaseReady.ok == true && steps.releaseReadyCheck.ok == true && steps.releaseReadyLatest.ok == true && exitCode == 0

zh.sub: 字段缺失、取值非法或步骤状态与决策不一致，当前结果不可直接用于放行。
zh.firstStep: 先重跑 release-ready-sync --json 生成完整结果，再重新判定。

en.sub: Missing/invalid fields or mismatch between step states and decision make this result unusable for release.
en.firstStep: Rerun release-ready-sync --json to regenerate a complete result, then re-evaluate.

vi.sub: Thieu/sai truong hoac khong khop giua trang thai buoc va decision, ket qua nay khong the dung truc tiep de phat hanh.
vi.firstStep: Chay lai release-ready-sync --json de tao ket qua day du, sau do danh gia lai.
